note: Adapted from Sjöstedt's (1900) description of the species, the original in Latin and German; the alate is described from De Geer's type specimen, while the soldier is transcribed from Hagen's description, the author having seen no specimen agreeing with that figure. Workers and nymphs are not described; the soldier's antennal count was written in Roman numerals in the original and is given here as a numeral, and the discrepancy between Hagen's total length and wingspan and the measured values of the original is not recorded, the relevant figures being incomplete in the scanned text; synonymy and literature citations, figure numbers and locality records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: After De Geer's figure and Hagen's description: milky white, becoming brownish yellow on drying with the head darker; head very large, oval, corneous, without compound eyes; mandibles sickle-shaped, shorter than the head, crossed; antennae as long as the head. Body length 6; head almost spherical; thorax flattened and much narrower than the head; antennae with only eleven segments, but this may be an error in the drawing. Overall morphology closer to Hodotermes. The specimens recorded do not agree with De Geer's figure.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Dried specimens jet black, mouthparts yellow-red; legs dirty yellow, tibiae distinctly darker. Head round, slightly longer than wide, slightly concave at the middle, without a fontanelle or with a very indistinct one; labrum small, narrowly transversely oval, anterior margin truncate, posterior margin curved, slightly inflated, only slightly paler than the frons; compound eyes very small, so that the ridge between the compound eyes and the lower margin of the head is relatively wide, its width about equal to the diameter of an ocellus. Pronotum as wide as the head including the compound eyes, semicircular. Wings translucent, greyish, costa brownish; media and submedia of the fore wing already fused at the wing base itself; lower margin of the wing weakly S-shaped. Wingspan 50–53, body length with wings 27–29, wing length 25, wing width 6, body with head 12–13.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alates swarmed out of the soil in a sparsely wooded area, while numerous soldiers appeared fighting one another.
